# radar-ng

> Hyper-local weather radar with a self-hosted tile pipeline: a CARROT-Weather-style Expo mobile app backed by a Rust + Temporal ingest/render pipeline on Kubernetes. Pure NOAA data (MRMS / HRRR / NWS / lightning), sub-2-minute radar refresh, rendered on hardware you own — no third-party aggregators, no API keys, no accounts.

radar-ng is a monorepo:
- `rust/` — Cargo workspace building one binary, `radar`: the HTTP API and tile server, the Temporal workers (MRMS radar, HRRR forecast, NAQFC air quality, lightning, tropical, nowcast, open-meteo sync, alerts), the schedule seeder (Temporal Schedules, no cron) and the `radar debug` diagnostics.
- `frontend/` — Expo SDK 58 / TypeScript iOS + Android app (the "Weather Clear" light UI).
- `web/` — the web radar (Vite + TypeScript).
- `deploy/` — the Dockerfile (three image targets), the Docker Compose stack, and the release runbook.

First-party container images publish to `ghcr.io/mitchross/radar-ng-{tile-server,temporal-worker,open-meteo-worker}`. The live Kubernetes manifests live in a separate gitops repo, `mitchross/talos-argocd-proxmox` (Talos + ArgoCD). The tile-server is the same Rust binary (`radar api`, axum): static tiles with immutable cache headers, the basemap, and the JSON API on one port.

## Data sources
All free, public, no keys:
- NOAA MRMS — base reflectivity radar (`noaa-mrms-pds` on S3), ~2-minute cadence.
- NOAA HRRR — high-resolution forecast model (`noaa-hrrr-bdp-pds` on S3).
- NOAA NAQFC/AQMv7 — air-quality guidance, bias-corrected PM2.5 + ozone (`noaa-nws-naqfc-pds` on S3), two cycles daily, 72 h horizon.
- NWS — active weather alerts (`api.weather.gov/alerts/active`).
- NHC — tropical cyclones (`nhc.noaa.gov/CurrentStorms.json`).
- Blitzortung — community lightning strike network.
- Open-Meteo — self-hosted forecast service (point/minutely/daily).
- Protomaps — vector basemap tiles (`build.protomaps.com`, date-stamped daily builds).

## Optional
